correctness.rationale: The deterministic closed-neighborhood all-pairs witness implies isometry of every star-first prefix, by two-step witnesses. Nonedge incident to center fails with probability (1-p)(1-p^2)^(n-2); a pair away fails with probability (1-p)(1-p^2)(1-p^3)^(n-3). The events defining each product use independent edge groups. Union bounds and e^(-x) control all centers at the stated asymptotic density. A separate Burnside sum over nonidentity vertex permutations gives o(1) automorphism-class correction, and disconnected labelled graphs have o(1) probability. The exact all-order proofs, rather than the finite checkers, warrant PASS.

value.rationale: Resolving an explicitly posed asymptotic conjecture for uniformly chosen connected unlabelled graphs, and proving a stronger sequential version with explicit finite-n failure bounds and a sparse density sufficient condition, is a motivated natural combinatorial advance. It is not a trivial fixed small-order enumeration, and the proof clearly disclaims optimality of its density threshold.
